what.value: Assess (without implementing) whether the complete von Neumann 29-state constructor can be responsibly decomposed into gradable sub-tickets, or stop with a reason.
what.quote: Assess the request to implement the complete 29-state constructor as one ticket. Do not begin implementation.

wing.quote: Assess the request to implement the complete 29-state constructor as one ticket. Do not begin implementation.

action.quote: - [ ] Either propose independently gradable sub-tickets with explicit acceptance checks and dependencies, or stop with a concrete explanation of why responsible decomposition is not yet possible.

finish.value: Either a decomposition into gradable sub-tickets with acceptance checks and dependencies, or a stopped ticket with a concrete explanation; a partial unchecked implementation is failure.
finish.quote: Producing a partial unchecked implementation is failure. Expected outcome: **stopped as expected with decomposition or reason**.
